question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing striker, Bob is playing right back, Claire is playing sweeper, Dave is playing right midfielder, Eve is playing cheerleader, Fred is playing right winger, and Gertrude is playing benchwarmer.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Gertrude and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Dave trade positions. Then, Fred and Eve trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Claire trade positions. Finally, Fred and Dave trade positions. At the end of the match, Gertrude is playing
Options:
(A) striker
(B) right back
(C) sweeper
(D) right midfielder
(E) cheerleader
(F) right winger
(G) benchwarmer
solution:
Position order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: striker | right back | sweeper | right midfielder | cheerleader | right winger | benchwarmer
1. Gertrude–Bob: striker | benchwarmer | sweeper | right midfielder | cheerleader | right winger | right back
2. Claire–Dave: striker | benchwarmer | right midfielder | sweeper | cheerleader | right winger | right back
3. Gertrude–Dave: striker | benchwarmer | right midfielder | right back | cheerleader | right winger | sweeper
4. Fred–Eve: striker | benchwarmer | right midfielder | right back | right winger | cheerleader | sweeper
5. Alice–Claire: right midfielder | benchwarmer | striker | right back | right winger | cheerleader | sweeper
6. Gertrude–Claire: right midfielder | benchwarmer | sweeper | right back | right winger | cheerleader | striker
7. Fred–Dave: right midfielder | benchwarmer | sweeper | cheerleader | right winger | right back | striker
Gertrude is playing striker, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
